events.did: rolled the inhaler between his fingers and assured Dani the compound was not harmful to the public and only for himself
events.quote_anchor: Victor rolled the inhaler between his fingers. “I can assure you,” he said, “it’s not harmful to the public. And I intend to use it only on myself.”

events.did: told the truth and asked Dani whether she had heard the term EO

events.did: flexed his hand and pinned Dani in place with his will as she reached for the phone
events.quote_anchor: Victor flexed his hand, and hers froze. Her whole body went taut and still, pinned in place by his will.

events.did: let go and returned Dani her autonomy, and she sank back into her chair
events.quote_anchor: He let go. She sagged a little as her autonomy returned, her body back under her own control.

events.did: lifted the inhaler to his mouth and breathed in, then ejected the cartridge and set the blue vial on the desk
events.quote_anchor: He ejected the inhaler cartridge and set the vivid blue vial on the desk.

events.did: explained the near-death experience in the Lockland lab, his second resurrection, and the choice between impotence and death
events.quote_anchor: He then explained, as succinctly as he could, about the near-death experience in the lab here at Lockland, all those years ago,

events.did: took the formula back down to studs to find a better solution and said she would need to run tests

relations.quote_anchor: In her, Victor saw a distorted version of himself. Not as he was, but as he’d been. Young and brilliant, ambitious and ignored.

relations.did: called out from the middle of the street, a voice Victor heard but that was not there

relations.did: told Victor that if he used his powers on her again without express permission, she would let him die
relations.quote_anchor: He glanced back. “If you ever use your powers on me again without express permission, I’ll let you die. Understood?”
